description: Northern Venezuela grapples with devastation after twin earthquakes, with the death toll climbing past 235 and thousands feared affected. Rescue efforts are underway, though residents report slow official responses. International aid is pouring in, with the US authorizing significant assistance and numerous countries dispatching rescue teams. Despite widespread destruction, the nation's vital oil infrastructure remains largely intact.
title: Venezuela quake leaves 235 dead as rescue efforts intensify

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Bill Gates revealed to Congress that Jeffrey Epstein attempted to leverage knowledge of Gates' extramarital affairs to re-establish contact after Gates sought to end their association. While no direct threats were made, Epstein allegedly used intermediaries for veiled warnings and explored blackmail tactics. Gates acknowledged past affairs, emphasizing Epstein's lack of involvement and that he only learned of them post-professional ties.
title: Bill Gates admits to the House panel that he had at least three extramarital affairs

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Teenage batting prodigy Vaibhav Sooryavanshi will use separate changing rooms during India's tours of Ireland and England due to UK child safeguarding laws. While he can join teammates for meetings and strategy, he'll change elsewhere. His parents are accompanying him throughout the tour, a special arrangement for the 15-year-old, ensuring his well-being under strict protocols.
title: Why Vaibhav Sooryavanshi will use a separate dressing room during Ireland T20Is

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Sooryavanshi will be 15 years and 91 days old if he takes the field. Tendulkar was 16 years and 205 days old when he made his international debut against Pakistan in 1989.
title: Before Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, who was the last teenager to play for India?

title: Watch: Abhijeet Dipke claims BJP workers assaulted reporters in front of Delhi Police

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: A shocking murder case involving realtor Ketan Agarwal has taken a dramatic turn as his fiancée, Siya Goyal, and her friend, Chetan Chaudhary, reportedly blame each other for his death. Police investigations reveal conflicting accounts, with evidence currently pointing towards Goyal as the alleged mastermind behind the plot. The couple was set to marry later this year.
title: 'She planned it, no he forced me': Twist in Pune realtor murder, Siya & Chetan turn on each other

title: ‘Satan took over me’: Afghan migrant gives bizarre reason for raping two minors in England

author: TNN
description: A young couple, Ritik Soni and Muskan Jain, were discovered deceased in a car near Ashoknagar, Madhya Pradesh. Police found a pistol, bloodied axe, and cutter at the scene, investigating possibilities of murder and suicide. The families allege a pre-planned murder, citing suspicious circumstances including a partially burnt face and a fire in the car.  The couple reportedly knew each other for years and had worked together previously.
title: 'Blood-stained axe, cutter, burnt face': Couple found dead inside car in Madhya Pradesh

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Pant returned to Delhi Capitals in a trade involving Kuldeep Yadav, ending a two-season stint with LSG and rejoining the franchise where he began his IPL career in 2016.
title: 'All confusing': De Villiers tears into DC's 'wishy-washy' ownership as Pant returns

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Ecuador delivered an incredible shock to the football world by defeating four-time champion Germany 2-1, catapulting themselves into the knockout rounds of the World Cup. The late-game heroics of Gonzalo Plata, who scored the decisive goal, thrilled a record crowd. After an early strike from Germany, Ecuador's Nilson Angulo equalized, setting the stage for Plata's unforgettable winner that disrupted Germany's winning streak.
title: FIFA WC: Plata's late strike stuns Germany as Ecuador seal knockout berth

author: MAHESH BUDDI
description: Anti-Corruption Bureau sleuths unearthed assets worth an estimated Rs 20 crore during a fresh probe into a revenue official already arrested for bribery. Searches at four locations revealed properties, cash, jewellery, and bank deposits disproportionate to her known income. The tahsildar, T Sucharita, was previously arrested in May for demanding and accepting a bribe for an official favour and is currently in judicial remand.
title: Cash, gold, diamonds and flats: Suspended Shamirpet tahsildar under ACB scanner over Rs 20cr assets

author: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY
description: A poignant sketch of parents, intended as a wedding anniversary gift, became a heartbreaking memento for Shatruhan Lal and Santosh Kumari after their 24-year-old son, 3D artist Nilesh Kumar, perished in the Aliganj fire. The drawing, a testament to his affection, was discovered among his belongings, a silent yet powerful final message of love.
title: Lucknow building fire: Artist’s anniversary sketch for parents reaches them after his death

author: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY AND ARSHAD AFZAAL KHAN
description: An FIR has been filed against eight individuals, including a cash-counting in-charge, following allegations of embezzlement of donations at the Ayodhya Ram Temple. A Special Investigation Team's preliminary report to the Chief Minister led to the registration of the case under charges of theft, criminal breach of trust, cheating, and conspiracy. The trust initiated a probe after financial irregularities surfaced, and police are now investigating the alleged diversion of funds.
title: Ram Temple ‘donation theft’ case: FIR filed against 8, including cash counting in-charge

author: SRIBALA VADLAPATLA
description: Telangana faces significant rainfall stress, with 17 out of 33 districts experiencing deficient or largely deficient rainfall less than a month into the monsoon. This shortfall, particularly in key agricultural areas, raises concerns for kharif sowing. While the state's overall deficit is currently within normal limits, the uneven distribution and severe deficits in some districts highlight a growing regional imbalance, prompting calls for contingency plans.
title: Monsoon misfires: Over half of Telangana districts face rainfall stress, Kharif sowing at risk

author: ADVITYA BAHL
description: A Ghaziabad family mourned and cremated Girdhar Bisht, believing him murdered, only for him to return home 13 days later. Bisht, who had been in jail and then went missing, claims he was meditating in Punjab. His reappearance has baffled neighbours and police, who are now tasked with identifying the body they cremated and investigating Bisht's erratic past and alleged disputes.
title: Day after tehrvi, ‘dead’ Ghaziabad man returns home

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Want to die as an Indian: Andhra woman gives up US citizenship at 94

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Disney has agreed to a $50 million settlement to resolve antitrust claims that it artificially boosted live TV streaming prices. The lawsuit alleged Disney leveraged its market power, particularly with ESPN, to force distributors to include its channels, driving up costs for services like YouTube TV. Consumers who subscribed between April 2019 and March 2026 may be eligible for a payout.
title: Disney agreed to pay $50 million to subscribers of YouTube TV, AT&T TV Now

author: MOHAMMED AKHEF
description: A shocking incident at a Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar daycare has led to a criminal case against its management. A 23-month-old child was allegedly bitten 25 times by another toddler after a staff member locked three children in a room unsupervised for 15 minutes. CCTV footage revealed the prolonged assault. The daycare has been ordered to shut down, with authorities investigating severe negligence.
title: Maharashtra daycare centre: Toddler bites another 25 times
